mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install drywall in a typical kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for kitchen drywall varies depending on the kitchen's size, complexity (e.g., number of corners, cutouts for cabinets or windows), and whether it's new construction or a renovation. Typically, hanging the drywall panels can take 1-3 days. Taping, mudding, and sanding, which involve multiple coats and drying times, usually add another 3-7 days. Overall, a complete kitchen drywall installation, ready for paint, often takes about one to two weeks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing drywall in a typical kitchen, including hanging, taping, mudding, and sanding, usually takes one to two weeks, depending on the kitchen's size and complexity.
